title: DECISION: unimplemented backends rejected at config validation with clear message
description: config.rs validate() explicitly matches BackendType::S3 | BackendType::Filesystem and returns a Err(Validation) with a message naming the unimplemented variants and directing the operator to use 'kubo' or 'lmdb'. The variants exist in the enum for future use. Without this check, an operator who writes 'type = "s3"' would silently fall through to an error much later in startup. Failing fast with a clear message at config validation is better than a panic or a cryptic runtime error.
